text.tspan: Copies the requested path and a single "a cursor was present" bit into project-owned
headers, overwriting anything the client sent, so a not-found boundary that App Router
gives no props can still name a way back. Owns trailing-slash normalization, so a cursor
is validated before a 308. Optional default-off maintenance gate (ADR-0031):503 before
content/API work; actual static files pass, missing candidates use a content-free
afterFiles fallback. No query values, no content reads, no secrets.

g.text: src/lib — domain contracts, data-access seams, and fixtures
